notes: «فحدثنا عن جبير بن نفير»: who is the subject of «فحدثنا» is not settled (Khalid b. Ma'dan, named only in the scene, or Hassan himself); Khalid is not added (rule 6); implicit transmission, so needs_ruling (rule 11)
«فسأله ... فقال سمعت النبي»: Jubayr asks and Dhu Mikhmar answers, so Dhu Mikhmar is the last link
«- وكان رجلا من أصحاب النبي -» is an editor gloss: left out
